summary: Identified 2 arbitrage opportunities with gap_score >= 7.0. Buildertrend (residential-focused) and Fieldwire (field management) are proven US winners but absent in Romania. Romania dominated by general ERPs (TotalSoft, Wizrom) lacking construction specialization. Critical constraint: Romania market ($5.95M) is 25x smaller than Poland and only 0.24% of US market. Procore's low adoption (~$400K despite $1.15B US revenue) signals high price sensitivity - its 46,000-276,000 RON/year pricing appears too expensive for market.
key_insights: Romania market dominated by local general ERPs, not specialized construction tools
Procore present but low adoption - pricing too high for market (46K-276K RON/year)
